names.note: The calendar's own name page for him, which day-candidates.mjs prints as `name: Владимир (Лозина-Лозинский), протоиерей, сщмч.`; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself declining the bare forename only. `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

birth.note: The reading at /Life/life4790.htm: «родился 26 мая 1885 года в городе Духовщина Смоленской губернии».

death.note: The day line closes «(1937)» and the reading at /Life/life4790.htm dates the shooting «13 (26) декабря того же года» — the Julian day with the civil one in parentheses, the year being 1937 either way. Only the year is recorded here; the source’s own pair is quoted in this note and not in the display.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 13 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Владимира , Александра , Иакова , Алексия , Григория пресвитеров (1937).»

attestations.note: The day’s ninth entry, a line of five presbyters of 1937, and the only one of the five with a reading behind it — `/Life/life4790.htm`, which is his alone. The line says «пресвитеров» and both the name page and the reading’s title say «протоиерей», archpriest, so the office is the source’s word and `presbyter` the line’s. The reading’s «Дни памяти» line gives three days — «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs, «8 июня (Петерб.)», the synaxis of the saints of St Petersburg, and «13 декабря» — of which only the last is a day of his own, and this folder renders on it. NO RELATED ROWS JOIN HIM TO THE OTHER FOUR OF THE LINE: the reading says he was shot at Novgorod by a troika of his own, and sharing a line is not a relation. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century «сщмч.» and «мч.» entries, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held him: a Cyrillic grep for «Лозина» over every `saint.json` returns nothing. The day page carries troparia and kontakia for five of the memories it heads, and none under his name.
